A '''Bith Jedi Scholar''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Lore Keeper]]. At some point during the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] life, the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] fought a [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|droid commando]] in a jungle-like environment, and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to cause the vines to [[Plant Surge|ensnare and trap]] the [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. The Jedi scholar was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to the Force, and had [[Color/Legends|yellow]] skin and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. The scholar was also adorned in a white-colored [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]]. During battle, the Bith used a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] containing a blue [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="JATM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bith Jedi Scholar appeared in an image created for the ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'', a resource guide for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The image was used to demonstrate a Force technique called "Plant Surge."
